title: jobs profile
description: What the jobs pipeline filters, pre-scores and scores against (docs/jobs/PLAN.md, Revision 2). Every saved version is kept on the server in <data>/jobs/profile/, never in the repo. Unknown keys are refused, so a typo can't silently do nothing.

position_types.description: What to look for. A job passes the title filter when its title contains one of a type's titles (whole words, any case).

projects.description: The scorer reads each project's name and summary, along with the resume.

companies.description: Companies of interest, in two lists (kind): large established companies and startups. Their boards are read every night, their jobs skip the pre-score threshold (not the filters), and the scorer reads both lists.

board.description: system:id; null until found (directory lookup or a pasted careers URL)

kind.description: which list: a large established company, or a startup. Missing (versions saved before Revision 8) means startup.

wants.description: In Alex's words: what to look for and what not, and in what order. The scorer's guide to what's relevant.

resume.description: Alex's current resume as plain text, uploaded (PDF or text) or pasted on the settings page. The scorer reads it with the projects. Missing: no resume.

places.description: {area name: [place names a job's location may contain]}

max_years.description: drop jobs that require more than this many years of experience

eligible.description: could obtain one (keeps 'ability to obtain' jobs)

exclude_titles.description: whole words or phrases; any match drops the job. Checked against what is left of the title after its matched position-type title is taken out, so 'member of technical staff' isn't dropped by 'staff', but 'staff software engineer' and 'senior member of technical staff' are.

full_time_only.description: drop jobs a source marks part-time, contract, temporary or internship

new_grad_only.description: keep only jobs with a sign they're for new grads: the title or the source's level, and with a description, a new-grad list or the description itself

min_hourly_pay.description: USD an hour; a job whose stated pay is clearly below it is dropped (a year is 2,080 hours). Unstated or unclear pay stays. 0 turns the check off.

threshold.description: pre-score points needed to reach the scoring call

max_candidates.description: most jobs sent to the scoring call in a night

top_n.description: jobs shown on the day's list

per_company.description: most jobs from one company on the day's list; the rest are counted under its last one (missing: no limit)

fresh_bonus.description: added to the model's score when ordering the list, by days since posting: {"1": 1} is +1 within a day. A date-only stamp counts whole days from the run's date, so a job dated yesterday is 1 day old (missing: no bonus)
